Survey: Most Indians Avoid Unsolicited Business Calls

A report by Truecaller and Tata Tele Business Services indicates that 79 percent of Indians avoid calls from unknown business numbers. This trend persists even though many prefer voice calls for business communication. The findings highlight a significant concern among the public regarding unsolicited business outreach.
